headline: Thursday Night Football: Colts visit Texans in high-stakes AFC South Week 11 battle
teaser: C.J. Stroud and the division-leading Texans defend home turf at NRG Stadium against Anthony Richardson and the dangerous Colts with AFC playoff seeding on the line.
story:
Week 11 of the NFL season kicks off under the prime-time lights on Thursday night, 19 November, as the Houston Texans host the Indianapolis Colts in a pivotal AFC South showdown at NRG Stadium.

Houston enters Thursday aiming to tighten its grip on first place in the division behind quarterback C.J. Stroud and an aggressive front seven led by Will Anderson Jr. The Texans defense has ranked among the league leaders in quarterback pressure rate, which will be tested against the electrifying athleticism of Colts signal-caller Anthony Richardson.

Indianapolis arrives with plenty of momentum and an explosive ground attack powered by Jonathan Taylor. With both franchises locked in the competitive AFC playoff picture, Thursday's clash offers decisive head-to-head tiebreaker consequences heading into the season's final stretch.
whyCareReason: A marquee divisional showdown between C.J. Stroud and Anthony Richardson that directly influences the AFC South championship race.
stakes: The winner takes command of the AFC South tiebreaker and strengthens their standing in the crowded AFC playoff bracket.
rivalryAngle: Bitter divisional rivalry between two young, ascending quarterbacks who have split their regular-season meetings over the past two seasons.
funFacts: The Colts and Texans have split their last four meetings, with three of those games decided by seven points or fewer.
Anthony Richardson has recorded at least one rushing touchdown in four consecutive games.
Houston edge rusher Will Anderson Jr. leads the AFC with 10 sacks through the opening 10 weeks.

keyPlayers.name: Anthony Richardson
keyPlayers.hook: Dual-threat dynamo capable of breaking open games with his arm strength and rushing ability.

keyPlayers.name: Jonathan Taylor
